title: Book One · Chapter 67: Behind the Counter
story:
Dad tells Ronan to wait by the front door.

Inside Mr Sun's shop, a white line marks the floor. It is in front of the counter. The line keeps people away from the work bench. Ronan puts both shoes behind it.

Mum sent him with Dad's lunch. School is closed for the afternoon. Ronan wants to watch Dad at work.

Mr Sun takes the cloth bag from him.

“He is finishing a job. You can sit here.”

The chair by the door has a low back. Ronan sits and tries not to turn round too often.

Dad is working on a loose handle. He works quietly. There are no loud bangs. He puts down one tool and checks the handle. Then he tries a smaller tool. Most of the time he looks at it.

A man comes in. He has a metal box. He wants it today.

Mr Sun looks inside. “I cannot say today until we check it.”

“It only stopped this morning.”

“Now I know the time,” Mr Sun says. “But what broke inside? We need to check that.”

The man sighs. He leaves the box and gives his name.

Ronan sees Mr Sun write the name on a paper card. He ties the card to the box. There are other cards on other things.

Dad finishes the handle. He moves it ten times. On the tenth turn, it makes a tiny click. He looks at Mr Sun.

“Not ready,” Dad says.

Mr Sun nods and carries the next job to another part of the bench.

Ronan's legs swing under the chair. He came here some time ago. Dad is still working on this one small thing.

At last Dad comes over. He washes his hands and opens the lunch bag.

“Did you see?” he asks.

“Yes. It still clicks.”

“It does.”

“Can you fix it?”

“I think so. I need to check the part underneath.”

Mr Sun sits on a stool with his own bowl. “How long will that take?” Mr Sun asks. “Check the time too. People need their things back. We cannot keep each job for ever.”

Dad looks at him. “I know.”

Dad speaks quietly. Both men look serious. Is Dad angry? Ronan is not sure.

He takes the empty cloth from the bag and folds it. It has a spot of soup on one corner.

“Can I wash this?”

“At home,” Dad says. “Your mum needs you back.”

Will Dad work here next week? Ronan wants to ask, but Mr Sun is still there. He does not want to ask in front of him.

Ronan is ready to go. A woman comes to collect a kettle. Mr Sun asks Dad for the job card. Dad checks the name on her small paper. Then he brings out the kettle. Ronan sees two kettles on the shelf. They are almost the same shape. The woman points to a dent in her kettle. She smiles. Dad asks her to try the lid before she takes it. Dad does not just hand her the kettle. He takes time to check it with her.

Dad walks him to the door.

“Thank you for the lunch.”

“Are you coming home for supper?”

“Yes. That one I can answer.”

Ronan smiles. Then he points through the door at the card on the metal box.

“You wrote the man's name.”

“Mr Sun did.”

“So it goes back to the right person.”

“Yes. That matters.”

Ronan steps into the sun. He leaves the white line and all the waiting jobs behind. At home, he washes the soup spot from the cloth. The handle still clicks. Ronan cannot fix it. But he can get this corner clean.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- counter＝柜台
- underneath＝在下面
- not ready＝还没好
- that matters＝那很重要

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：bench＝工作台；kettle＝水壶；dent＝凹痕。

## 读句提示

**He has a metal box.**

他／拿着／一个金属箱。has在这里表示“有、拿着”，不是完成时。

## 理解问题

1. MrSun为什么不马上答应当天修好？
2. Ronan在修理柜台看到了哪些与想象不同的工作？
